title: PatchTaskRequest
description: Request body for patching a task.

attributes.description: This is a schema free data tuple to pass-on specific data, depending on the outboundType. Supports a maximum of 30 tuples. Each tuple can have a key up to 200 bytes (up to 200 UTF-8 characters) and a value up to 1024 bytes (up to 1024 UTF-8 characters).
